title: Target Acquisition Officer (III) (CWO5 to WO) PMOS, DC CD&I
raw_text:
2.     MOS 0803, Target Acquisition Officer (III) (CWO5 to WO) PMOS, DC CD&I

    a. Summary. Target Acquisition Officers are special staff officers
responsible for advising artillery, maneuver, MAGTF, and joint commanders at
the tactical and operational levels on all aspects of the targeting process,
as well as the planning and integration of target acquisition assets and
related fire support systems. They supervise, coordinate, and guide the
execution of targeting in accordance with the commander's guidance. They
also assist and facilitate commanders and their staffs with integrating
capabilities and synchronizing the execution of appropriate fires and
activities through the joint targeting cycle to create specific lethal and/or
nonlethal effects. Additionally, they supervise the task organization and
employment of the target acquisition assets, specifically survey, acoustic,
meteorological, and counter battery radar systems. Target Acquisition
Officers are directly responsible for the training and readiness of the
targeting and target acquisition personnel and equipment.

       b.    Prerequisites

        (1) Must have previously served in one of the following MOSs 0842,
0844, 0847, 0848, 0861, or 0871.




                                           1-52                     Enclosure (1)
 1110                                                                NAVMC 1200.1L



            (2) Must have completed one of the following courses:

            (a) Marine Artillery Operations Chief Course (A204801), U.S. Army
Field Artillery School, Ft Sill, OK.

            (b) Marine Corps Fire Support Chief Course (A20ANY1), U.S. Army
Field Artillery School, Ft Sill, OK.

        (3) Security requirement: Must possess a secret security clearance.
Dependent on billet, may be required to meet sensitive compartmented
information (SCI) eligibility guidelines based on a single scope background
investigation/tier 5 (T5) investigation.

       c.   Requirements

        (1) Complete the Warrant Officer Basic Course (WOBC) (M02RMN4) at the
soonest available course after selection.

        (2) Must complete the Target Acquisition Officer Basic Course (TAOBC)
(A200H51) within 18 months of selection for both active duty and reserves.

    d. Duties. For a complete listing of duties and tasks, refer to
reference (k), Artillery Training and Readiness Manual.

    e. Related Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) Title and Code.
Artillery and Missile Officers 55-1014.

       f.   Related Military Skill.   None.

nlx_method: NLx employer-demand profiles; private-only ownership unverified. Six-digit profiles pool specialty weighted task incidences after the existing review exclusion mask and five-job task-support floor; destination SOCs require 200 postings and nonzero tasks. Military profiles use binary accepted task presence and the same NLx reference RCA weights as civilian profiles: reciprocal positive task shares (zero weight for reference-absent tasks) of pooled retained support-five NLx weighted incidences across 1,016 reference specialties (912 eligible comparison candidates), sqrt(q * rca_weight), then L2 normalization and cosine. No military crosswalk codes enter the task ranking. All positive top-20 results retained; zero-similarity destinations are not recommendations. Shared field/rating duties are included; general Naval Standards remain separate by paygrade. Summary compares non-future individual source entries (versions can repeat) with nonempty reference sets; grouped, future and general-standard entries remain in all outputs. Hit@k is the fraction with at least one reference SOC recovered; ties are averaged exactly. References outside NLx remain in denominators. DMDC reference status is from July 2024, not current 2026 status.
